note.question: What determines the benefits of completing a trial early and the cost of accelerating a trial by maximizing the net present value of drug cumulative profit?
note.overview: Clinical trials are crucial to new drug development. This study investigates optimal patient enrollment in clinical trials with interim analyses, which are analyses of treatment responses from patients at intermediate points. The model considers uncertainties in patient enrollment and drug treatment effectiveness.
